panels.description:
Number of Notifications in the notifications_queue table which are marked as "pending" for each channel type. 

Note that "pending" notifications will persist in the queue for 1 hour, after which they will be dropped.
panels.title: Pending Notifications in Queue (Per Channel)

panels.description:
Number of Notifications in the notifications_queue table which are marked as "sent" for each channel type. 

Note that once a Notification has been "sent", it will persist in the table for 30 minutes before being garbage collected.
panels.title: Sent Notifications in Queue (Per Channel)

panels.description:
Number of Notifications in the notifications_queue table which are marked as "pending" for each event type. 

Note that "pending" notifications will persist in the queue for 1 hour, after which they will be dropped.
panels.title: Pending Notifications in Queue (Per Event)

panels.description:
Number of Notifications in the notifications_queue table which are marked as "sent" for each event type. 

Note that once a Notification has been "sent", it will persist in the table for 30 minutes before being garbage collected.
panels.title: Sent Notifications In Queue (Per Event)

panels.description: Notifications that have been deleted from the database because they were pending and went past their 1 hour expiration
panels.title: Garbage Collection Pending (i.e. Dropped) Notifications

panels.description: Notifications that have been deleted from the database because they were sent and went past their 30 min expiration
panels.title: Garbage Collection Sent Notifications

panels.description: For the Notifications still in the queue, shows the average amount of time those Notifications have spent in the queue.
panels.title: Average Pending Notification Duration

panels.description:
For the "sent" Notifications still in the queue, shows the average amount of time those Notifications have spent in the queue.

Note that once sent, Notifications persist in the queue for 30 mins, and so this metric may be delayed by approximately that duration.
panels.title: avg ms/notifications_queue_sent_duration_milliseconds
